## Comparación Normal vs t de Student

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 5.8
#| warning: false

par(
  mar = c(5,5,3,1),
  bg = "white",
  family = "sans"
)

# Valores de x
x <- seq(-5, 5, length = 600)

# Colores
col_norm <- "#1f4e79"
col_t3   <- "#b23a48"
col_t10  <- "#2e7d32"

# Gráfico principal
plot(
  x, dnorm(x),
  type = "l",
  lwd = 4,
  col = col_norm,
  ylim = c(0,0.42),
  xlab = "x",
  ylab = "f(x)",
  main = "Distribución normal vs t de Student",
  cex.main = 1.5,
  cex.lab = 1.3,
  cex.axis = 1.1
)

grid(col = "gray88")

# Curvas t
lines(
  x, dt(x,3),
  lwd = 4,
  col = col_t3,
  lty = 2
)

lines(
  x, dt(x,10),
  lwd = 4,
  col = col_t10,
  lty = 3
)

# Línea vertical en 0
abline(v = 0, lty = 2, col = "gray50")

# Leyenda elegante
legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c(
    expression(N(0,1)),
    expression(t(3)),
    expression(t(10))
  ),
  col = c(col_norm, col_t3, col_t10),
  lwd = 4,
  lty = c(1,2,3),
  bty = "n",
  cex = 1.1
)

# Texto explicativo
text(
  -3.8, 0.33,
  labels = "Colas más pesadas\npara pocos grados\nde libertad",
  cex = 1,
  col = col_t3
)

text(
  2.7, 0.39,
  labels = "La distribución t\nse aproxima a la normal",
  cex = 1,
  col = col_t10
)
```
